_about: Cue kind -> earshot bank sound for the Romancing the Atom reel (achbar-atom-reel). Its cues.json holds three kinds: type (each typed character, size = font px), slam (each kinetic letter landing, size = font px) and zip (each leader line drawing). Bands pick knobs by size: the first band whose size_max covers the cue wins; a band with no size_max catches the rest. seeds gives several takes of one band, dealt so the same take never plays twice in a row. pan is the random spread, as in sfx.py. peak is the take's sample peak in dBFS (earshot --peak); pitch, dur, apex and weight pass through to earshot.

type._why: a typed character is a key: small captions get the light key, mid type the crisp one, big type the deep thock (sfx.py made small type brighter and big type louder)

slam._why: a kinetic letter landing is a wooden knock, lower and louder for big type

zip._why: a leader line drawing out to its label: a short rising zip
